title: Pixels
content:
# Pixels

Read, create and configure TikTok Pixels, manage their events, share them through Business Center and install them on Shopify or WordPress.

import { Tab, Tabs } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/tabs';

Manage TikTok Pixels through the platform-neutral [tracking tags API](/guides/pixels) on your `tiktokads` connection. Read, create and configure a pixel, manage its events and counts, share it, and install it.

## Before you start

A connection authorized before TikTok's Pixel Management permission answers every pixel call with `403`. [Reconnect](/platforms/tiktok-ads#connect) TikTok Ads to grant it.

## Read the tag

`GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/tracking-tags` lists the pixels of every advertiser on the connection. `GET .../tracking-tags/{tagId}` reads one, with its install `code` and its events.

<Tabs items={['Node.js', 'Python', 'curl']}>
<Tab value="Node.js">
```typescript
const { data } = await zernio.trackingtags.getTrackingTag({
  path: { accountId: '66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d', tagId: '7412345678901234567' }
});
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Python">
```python
data = client.tracking_tags.get_tracking_tag(
    account_id="66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d",
    tag_id="7412345678901234567",
)
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl "https://zernio.com/api/v1/accounts/66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d/tracking-tags/7412345678901234567" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY"
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

Response (`200`), trimmed:

```json
{
  "platform": "tiktokads",
  "tag": {
    "id": "7412345678901234567",
    "siteTagId": "D00IKHRC77UE0J0RTNHG",
    "name": "Storefront pixel",
    "platform": "tiktokads",
    "kind": "pixel",
    "status": "active",
    "ownerAdAccountId": "7301234567890123456",
    "code": "<script>!function (w, d, t) {...}</script>",
    "events": [
      { "id": "e1", "name": "Purchase", "type": "SHOPPING", "siteEvent": "purchase", "siteEventId": "Purchase", "status": "active" }
    ]
  }
}
```

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| `id` | The numeric `pixel_id`: what `promotedObject.pixelId` takes on [conversion campaigns](/platforms/tiktok-ads/create-ads#conversion-campaigns) |
| `siteTagId` | The alphanumeric `pixel_code` that `ttq.load()` and Events Manager use |
| `events` | TikTok's `type`, the matching `siteEvent`, and `siteEventId`, the name `ttq.track()` fires |

`adAccountId`, the advertiser id, is optional on per-pixel calls. Without it, Zernio searches every advertiser on the connection, and a pixel shared into several advertisers resolves to its owner's copy.

## Create a pixel

`POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/tracking-tags` creates a pixel on one advertiser. Names are at most 40 characters, with no emojis.

<Tabs items={['Node.js', 'Python', 'curl']}>
<Tab value="Node.js">
```typescript
const { data } = await zernio.trackingtags.createTrackingTag({
  path: { accountId: '66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d' },
  body: { adAccountId: '7301234567890123456', name: 'Storefront pixel' }
});
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Python">
```python
data = client.tracking_tags.create_tracking_tag(
    account_id="66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d",
    ad_account_id="7301234567890123456",
    name="Storefront pixel",
)
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl -X POST "https://zernio.com/api/v1/accounts/66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d/tracking-tags" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "adAccountId": "7301234567890123456", "name": "Storefront pixel" }'
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

Response (`201`):

```json
{
  "platform": "tiktokads",
  "tag": {
    "id": "7412345678901234567",
    "siteTagId": "D00IKHRC77UE0J0RTNHG",
    "name": "Storefront pixel",
    "platform": "tiktokads",
    "kind": "pixel",
    "status": "active",
    "creationTime": 1804064400,
    "ownerAdAccountId": "7301234567890123456",
    "code": "<script>!function (w, d, t) {...}</script>",
    "events": []
  }
}
```

<Callout type="warn">
The create is not idempotent and TikTok has no pixel delete, so never retry it blindly. List the pixels after a timeout.
</Callout>

Creating an event is not idempotent either. TikTok returns no id for it, and refreshes a pixel's event list only every few hours.

When the new event is not listed yet, the response carries `id: ""` and `status: "pending"`. Read the events again later for its id.

## Pixel operations

| Operation | Behavior |
|-----------|----------|
| Update (`PATCH .../tracking-tags/{tagId}`) | `name`, `enableAutomaticMatching`, `automaticMatchingFields` (Meta's codes folded onto TikTok's email, phone, name, address and external id switches; gender and date of birth answer `400`), and first-party cookies as `enableFirstPartyCookies` (boolean) or `firstPartyCookieStatus` (`empty` answers `400`). Other fields answer `400`. |
| Stats (`GET .../stats`) | Per-event counts from TikTok's `/pixel/event/stats`, 7 days by default and at most 30 per request, bucketed by whole UTC days. TikTok reports no last-fired time. |
| Share (`.../shared-accounts`) | Business Center pixel links: list, link and unlink advertisers. The pixel must be an asset of a Business Center the connection manages (its owner Business Center, or one of the connection's). `sharedAccounts[].businessId` is the Business Center. |
| Conversion events (`.../events`) | List, create and update the pixel's events. Create takes `type` (TikTok's event type) or `siteEvent`, plus optional `name`, `defaultValue` and `currency` (USD, JPY or INR). Update changes `name`, `defaultValue` and `currency` only: TikTok's `/pixel/event/update/` takes no type, so create a new event instead. |
| Diagnostics | `501`: TikTok has no pixel diagnostics endpoint (`/pixel/diagnostic/`, `/pixel/diagnostics/` and `/pixel/health/` answer `404`). Use the stats or Events Manager. |
| Users and partners | `501`. |
| Delete | Not offered: TikTok has no pixel delete endpoint (`POST /pixel/delete/` answers HTTP `404`, and it is absent from TikTok's pixel endpoint index and SDK specs). |
| Install | Shopify and WordPress. WordPress gets TikTok's base code (`ttq.load` plus `ttq.page`); Shopify sends each [storefront event](/platforms/shopify/tracking-pixels#event-mapping) to `analytics.tiktok.com/api/v2/pixel`, the endpoint TikTok's own pixel script calls (undocumented), with the `ttclid` click id kept first-party, the `_ttp` browser id reused and an event id for dedup with the Events API. |

Install targets: a connected [Shopify](/platforms/shopify/tracking-pixels) store or [WordPress](/platforms/wordpress/tracking-pixels) site.

## How it behaves

- **Event deletes answer `501`.** TikTok's `/pixel/event/delete/` answers OK but the event stays on the pixel, checked hours later and across every id format its spec allows.
- **Events in use stay.** TikTok also refuses to delete an event an ad group still uses.

## If it fails

| Error | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `403` on every pixel call | The connection predates TikTok's Pixel Management permission | Reconnect TikTok Ads to grant it. |
| `400` on a share | The pixel is not an asset of a Business Center the connection manages | Transfer it into Business Center (Assets, Events), then retry. |
| `400` on an update | A field TikTok does not store, or gender and date of birth in `automaticMatchingFields` | Send only the fields in the update row above. |
| `501 platform_not_supported` on an event `DELETE` | TikTok's delete call reports success without removing the event | Delete the event in TikTok Events Manager. |
| A second pixel after a retry | The create is not idempotent | List the pixels after a timeout instead of retrying. |

## Related

- [Create a campaign](/platforms/tiktok-ads/create-ads#conversion-campaigns): the conversion campaign that uses the pixel id.
